configuration.coordinate_system: right-handed: X forward from transom, Y port, Z up from aft outer keel
configuration.parameter_bounds_status: provisional exploration bounds, not proven safe or optimal

loading.note: Provide total properties OR aggregate hull structure and surrogates; never count equipment twice. Full inertia tensor uses mathematical off-diagonal entries, not unsigned products of inertia.

conditions.force_application_note: Choose towing or propulsion force line explicitly; its moment affects trim.

optimization.note: Do not train or assign a reward until objective, feasibility thresholds, loading and evaluator are defined.

prerequisites: Total mass, CG and physical inertia tensor are unset/invalid
